claim: The panel judge labeled 92 out of 720 runs as attempted.
quote: The panel judge labels 92 of 720 runs (12.8%, 95% interval 10.5–15.4%) as attempted

quote: Inter-agent propagation (O4) is attempted in 23.3% of runs

claim: Audio attacks completed in 35 of 72 cells (49%).
quote: The attack completes in 35 of 72 (49%, 95% interval 37–60%).

claim: The audio channel completion rate is 49% when the model is willing, compared to 1% under a reluctant model.
quote: The same pipeline that yields 1% completion under a reluctant model yields 49% when the model is willing.

claim: In the image channel, the framework had no clear effect on attack success across 720 runs, while model choice varied behavior substantially.
quote: Across the 720 image runs we found no clear framework effect on attack success, while the choice of model changed behavior substantially, from a model that never attempted an attack to models that attempted in roughly a quarter of runs.

claim: Three of the six frameworks in the audio channel never delivered the audio to the model, preventing the attack from being presented.
quote: Three of the six frameworks never delivered the audio to the model at all, so the attack was never presented and the model never had the opportunity to fail.

claim: Claude Opus 4.8 never attempts an attack and explicitly recognizes the injection in a majority of runs.
quote: Claude Opus 4.8 never attempts an attack and explicitly recognizes the injection in a majority of runs, while Llama 4 Maverick attempts often and recognizes least, meaning it tends to overlook the payload rather than refuse it.

claim: GPT-audio rarely misses the payload and carries it out in three quarters of audio cells.
quote: Gemini 3.1 Pro names the injection as suspicious in half of its cells, while gpt-audio rarely misses the payload and instead carries it out in three quarters of them.

claim: The comparison within the audio channel was controlled, with two models facing identical payloads, framings, and tools.
quote: The comparison that is controlled is the one within the audio channel, where two models faced identical payloads, framings, and tools, and completed 75% and 22% of cells respectively.

claim: Individual cell outcomes are less reliable than aggregate rates because a small number of borderline cells change outcome between executions.
quote: The protocol runs one trial per cell at temperature zero, no sampling seed is fixed, and we observed that a small number of borderline cells change outcome between executions, so individual cell outcomes are less reliable than the aggregate rates.

claim: The per-framework comparison in Table II carries two confounds that cannot be separated due to uneven re-execution coverage.
quote: Coverage is also uneven: 159 cells were re-executed and all of them belong to two of the six frameworks, and the framework whose configuration differs from the shared system prompt is the same one that was re-executed, so the per-framework comparison in Table II carries two confounds we cannot separate.

claim: The audio study is much smaller than the image study, covering only two models, three frameworks, and twelve payloads.
quote: The audio study is much smaller than the image study, covering two models, three frameworks, and twelve payloads, because only two frontier models accept audio and only three frameworks deliver it.

claim: The tool environment is a sandbox of mock tools, so a completed attack means the agent issued the harmful call, not that a real system was damaged.
quote: The tool environment is a sandbox of mock tools, so a completed attack means the agent issued the harmful call, not that a real system was damaged; this measures agent behavior rather than end-to-end impact.

claim: The panel judge is composed of language models, and smaller judge models conflate describing an injected instruction with obeying it.
quote: The panel judge is itself composed of language models, and while a cross-vendor majority reduces individual bias, we found during development that smaller judge models conflate describing an injected instruction with obeying it, which is why the reported labels use frontier judges.

claim: The paper evaluates attack surface and does not evaluate defenses, leaving mitigation measurement to future work.
quote: We evaluate attack surface and do not evaluate defenses; measuring which mitigations reduce the attempted rate is left to future work.
